title: Review (Supported): on fresh seeds 3-4 physarum clusters with Jones-type agent turnover stay bounded and wander (2.0-2.8 body lengths) but never split (0 splits, 5 merges each)
summary: labkit runs of c19's world.py on seeds 3 and 4 (128^2, 5000 steps, spf 25) with the finding's stated settings, WORLD_P {"SA":120,"RA":45,"frac":0.01,"dmax":25}: 6-11 clusters from a sparse uniform start, 8 and 7 persistent tracks, bounded (max/min area 3.67 and 4.13), up to 2.8 and 2.0 body lengths, 0 splits and 5 merges on each seed. This matches the finding's seeds 0-1 (0 splits, 5 and 2 merges, 6-7 persistent). With the world file's own defaults (SA 45, frac 0.15, dmax 40) the picture is different: tangled trails, 65-125 splits that all re-merge, no persistent tracks.

observations.D: rerun/seed3-4/FACTS.md: 0 splits, 5 merges, 7-8 persistent bounded clusters (negative replicated)

verdicts.limitation: The world file's defaults are not the finding's settings; a reader running world.py as shipped gets tangled trails with many non-persistent splits instead. I did not rerun the no-turnover arm or the threshold screen.
